In normal mode, the app opens the link and you press Join. When the optional Accessibility add-on is enabled manually, it clicks only “View group”, “Join group”, or “Request to join” inside WhatsApp, can queue up to 1,000,000 links and processes no more than 1000 links per explicit run before stopping until the user explicitly continues.
If the selected option is unavailable, the app safely falls back to the browser.

The app requests no Internet or broad-storage permission. Accessibility is optional and must be enabled manually in system settings; it is restricted to WhatsApp/WhatsApp Business and the explicit group-join or request-to-join action. Sessions stay in private app storage and backup is disabled.

Optional mode for a local queue of up to 1,000,000 links. Each explicit run processes no more than 1000 links, clicks only the explicit view-group, join, or request-to-join action in WhatsApp, WhatsApp Business, or the supported cloned package, and waits for your chosen delay before opening the next link. It does not type messages or read chats.

System settings will open. Select “Smart WhatsApp Group Link Manager” and enable the service. Then start the session manually from the app; it can keep up to 1,000,000 links queued, processes no more than 1000 links per run, and stops automatically.

Runs up to 1000 links per explicit run inside the selected WhatsApp app in the same Android profile. It detects group/community invitations and Join/Request/Confirm controls; when Community mode is enabled it processes semantically identified subgroup rows one by one, returns, and continues. It does not read messages, send content, or bypass WhatsApp restrictions.
Started the next batch of remaining links.
Choose the delay after one link finishes and before the next opens. Allowed range: 0 to 60 seconds; 0 opens the next link immediately after the minimal UI-settle guard.

ENABLED_SETTING_PRESENT_BUT_MANAGER_DISABLED — Android\'s setting names the service, but AccessibilityManager does not treat it as active here. Toggle the service off/on in the main Accessibility settings after the work copy is installed.

WAITING_FOR_LOCAL_BIND — enable or restart the service, then return to the app.
